title: Technical Content Researcher & Writer Internship in Thane, Navi Mumbai, Dombivli, Kalyan, Mumbai
Senior Tally Support Specialist
description:
Senior Tally Support Specialist (Non\-Programming Role) – Urgently Hiring
 



  





**Company:** 
 Absoft Solutions
 



**Location:** 
 Dombivli, Maharashtra
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Work Mode:** 
 On\-site (Field Visits Required)
 



  





 About Absoft Solutions
 



  





 Founded in
 **2005** 
 by
 **Arun W. Bhagat** 
 , Absoft Solutions is a
 **5\-Star Certified Tally Partner** 
 with strong technical expertise across
 **Mumbai, the UAE, and African markets** 
 .
 



 We specialize in enterprise accounting and business solutions, offering end\-to\-end Tally services including licensing, upgrades, TSS renewals, deployments, implementation, AMC, corporate training, data services, and long\-term technical support. Our dedicated TDL development team works closely with clients to deliver scalable, business\-specific solutions while our support team ensures exceptional customer satisfaction through timely assistance and proactive service.
 



 We are currently
 **urgently hiring** 
 an experienced
 **Senior Tally Support Specialist** 
 to join our growing team.
 



  





 Role Overview
 



  





 This is a
 **full\-time, on\-site** 
 position based in
 **Kalyan\-Dombivli** 
 .
 



 As a
 **Senior Tally Support Specialist** 
 , you will provide advanced technical and functional support for Tally software, helping clients resolve issues, optimize workflows, and maximize the value of their Tally investment.
 



 This role involves
 **regular field visits to client locations** 
 for implementation, troubleshooting, training, and support.
 



**Important:** 
 This is
 **NOT a Developer role. This is a non\-coding, non\-programming position focused entirely on Tally implementation, troubleshooting, customer support, and client service.** 




  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  




* Provide advanced technical support for
 **TallyPrime and previous versions of Tally ERP** 
 .
* Install, configure, upgrade, and troubleshoot Tally software.
* Handle Tally AMC/ASSC support and client service requests.
* Resolve issues related to Data Splitting, Data Synchronization, Data Migration, Backup \& Restore, and Password Recovery.
* Analyze client accounting and business workflows and recommend suitable Tally features and best practices.
* Conduct onsite and remote troubleshooting for software and data\-related issues.
* Visit client locations for implementation, support, training, and system health checks.
* Conduct end\-user training and assist clients in maximizing software utilization.
* Coordinate with the TDL Development Team for customization requests and enhancement requirements.
* Maintain detailed documentation of support cases, resolutions, and customer interactions.
* Collaborate with the Sales and Implementation teams to ensure seamless customer onboarding and satisfaction.



  





 Required Skills \& Qualifications
 



  




* **Minimum 3 years of hands\-on experience in Tally Technical Support is mandatory.**
* Strong expertise in
 **TallyPrime and Tally ERP** 
 .
* Excellent knowledge of installation, configuration, licensing, upgrades, backups, and troubleshooting.
* Experience handling Tally.Server and enterprise deployments is an added advantage.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent customer service and communication skills.
* Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to end users.
* Ability to manage multiple client engagements and prioritize effectively.
* Degree or diploma in Commerce, Accounting, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred.



 Mandatory Requirements
 



  





**Please read carefully before applying** 



* **Experience in Tally Technical Support is mandatory.**
* **Candidates without prior Tally Support experience will NOT be considered or shortlisted.**
* This is a
 **non\-coding, non\-programming role** 
 . Candidates looking for Development or Software Development positions should not apply.
* This role requires
 **regular field visits to client locations** 
 . Applicants must be comfortable traveling for customer support and implementation activities.



  





 Why Join Absoft Solutions?
 



  




* Competitive salary with performance\-based incentives.
* Opportunity to work with one of India's leading
 **5\-Star Certified Tally Partners** 
 .
* Exposure to enterprise Tally implementations and large\-scale business solutions.
* Work alongside an experienced TDL Development and AI Solutions team.
* Professional growth and continuous learning opportunities.
* Supportive, collaborative, and technology\-driven work environment.



  





 Preferred Candidates
 



 Candidates residing in
 **Kalyan, Dombivli, Thane, or nearby locations** 
 will be preferred for ease of commuting.
 



  





 Job Details
 


* **Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
* **Work Mode:** 
 On\-site
* **Location:** 
 Dombivli, Maharashtra
* **Field Visits:** 
 Required
